<!-- pr-reviewer: b23564a47a18885330f6ad666fa72ebca6f2c90e -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (one cosmetic note below, not blocking).

**What looks good**
- Layout only. Load other / Edit / Clear push `LoadMachineDialog` / `EditMachineDialog` / `ClearMachine` (machine_page.rs `actions`), the combo pushes `LoadBuiltinMachine(name)`, ownership still pushes `SetupOwnMachine`: same commands and arguments as the old `machine_section`. No direct field pokes; Clear stays undoable (pinned, Undo restores).
- No readout row dropped: the overview grid with the Source row, the no-machine message and the "Load machine (.mch)" button are all kept; the active/inactive condition is still `editable()` in setup_pages.rs, and the rotary section still follows the machine page. The only removed text is the bare "Machine" label, replaced by the group titles.
- ui layering holds (machine_page.rs uses only `camcraft_app::{machine, posting}` read helpers and `CommandKind`, as the old code did). No PNG changed. machine_page.rs is 101 lines, tests/machine_page.rs 164, setup_pages.rs 257; pages.rs shrank by 69 lines. Provenance lines present. Decision file added; `Changelog:` line and `Refs #1440` in the body; no process files touched.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main - already up to date, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- --test-threads=1` (CWD crates/ui) | 680 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` | clean |

Mutations I applied to a sample (machine_page tests re-run):
- Clear queues `EditMachineDialog` instead of `ClearMachine`: red (buttons test).
- Drop the Edit button: red (buttons, groups).
- Move the rotary section above the machine page: red (rotary-rows-last).
- Edit button queues `LoadMachineDialog` instead of `EditMachineDialog`: stays green (see note 2).

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. Post page separator: `ownership` used to end with `ui.separator()` only after its full body; its early return (no setup context, "A document without setups uses...") drew none. The PR now draws the separator in the Post arm of setup_pages.rs:50 unconditionally, so the Post page of the implicit (no-setup) context gains one separator it did not have. With a named setup it is drawn exactly once, same position as before. Cosmetic; guard with `if ctx.is_some()` if you want it identical.
2. As the author states, Load other and Edit are not click-tested, so swapping which of the two dialog commands each button queues is not caught. A two-line click test for each would close it.
3. The dropped separator on the Machine page is not needed (the groups separate the sections), so no change there.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
